topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I thought the day would be filled with laughter, the kind that sneaks up on you, but instead, it’s just me and my thoughts. I keep replaying the moment I overheard the cancelled plans, the way my hands went cold and my breath hitched. I should be happy they even tried to plan it, but all I can think about is the empty room, the silence. Now I’m stuck pretending everything is fine when it’s not, when it all feels so wrong. I don’t know how to face the day, how to make the unease disappear. Maybe I should reach out to someone, but what if that makes things worse?
